decisions.what: Wrapped all event binding in DOMContentLoaded listener
decisions.why: Spec requires event binding code to be scoped inside DOMContentLoaded to ensure DOM is parsed before querying elements and to prevent memory leaks

decisions.what: Replaced event delegation (single .button-grid listener) with individual per-button listeners via forEach
decisions.why: Spec explicitly requires querySelectorAll('[data-digit]').forEach and querySelectorAll('[data-operator]').forEach with individual addEventListener calls

decisions.what: Replaced if/else keyboard handler with switch statement
decisions.why: Spec explicitly requires a switch(event.key) structure for the keydown handler

decisions.what: Used appendDigit/appendDecimal/setOperator directly in event handlers instead of handleDigit/handleDecimal/handleOperator
decisions.why: Spec specifies appendDigit, setOperator, and appendDecimal as the functions to call from event handlers; kept existing handleDigit/handleDecimal/handleOperator functions unchanged as they were not in scope to remove

decisions.what: setOperator('−') used for keyboard '-' key (Unicode minus sign)
decisions.why: Spec explicitly states case '-': setOperator('−') with the Unicode minus sign character to match the display representation

decisions.what: Stored display element reference in DOMContentLoaded scope
decisions.why: Spec requires selecting the display element and storing a reference; kept in local closure scope to avoid global variable
